mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, activity_code, activity_name, start_time, end_time, activity_type, appored FROM ofa_activities WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT a.activity_id as subActivityId, a.activity_code as subActivityCode, a.activity_name as subActivityName, a.activity_type as subActivityType, a.start_time as subStartTime, a.end_time as subEndTime, a.appored as subAppored, CASE a.appored WHEN '0' THEN '待审批' WHEN '1' THEN '发布中' WHEN '2' THEN '已发布报名中' WHEN '3' THEN '活动中' WHEN '4' THEN '已结束' WHEN '5' THEN '已归档' ELSE '未知' END as subApporedName, CASE a.activity_type WHEN '0' THEN '经颅磁技术' WHEN '1' THEN 'VR技术' WHEN '2' THEN '生物反馈技术' WHEN '3' THEN '内观技术' WHEN '9' THEN '其它' ELSE '未知' END as subActivityTypeName, -- 获取子活动的评价等级（取最新的评价） (SELECT rating FROM ofa_activities_review r WHERE r.activity_id = a.activity_id AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) as rating, -- 判断子活动是否有人参与（有经颅磁数据或技术数据） CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tmsdata t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tech t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as participated FROM ofa_activities a WHERE a.parent_activity_id = #{parentActivityId} AND a.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY a.order_num
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as signupCount FROM ofa_activities_signup WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as checkinCount FROM ofa_activities_checkin WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) as liveCount FROM ofa_activities_live WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '1'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = '1' THEN 1 END) as goodReviewCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = '2' THEN 1 END) as mediumReviewCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = '3' THEN 1 END) as badReviewCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = '1' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) ELSE 0.0 END as goodRate FROM ofa_activities_review WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.activity_type = '0' THEN '经颅磁' WHEN a.activity_type = '1' THEN 'VR技术' WHEN a.activity_type = '2' THEN '生物反馈' WHEN a.activity_type = '3' THEN '内观技术' WHEN a.activity_type = '9' THEN '其它技术' ELSE '未知技术' END FROM ofa_activities a WHERE a.parent_activity_id = #{activityId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tmsdata t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tech t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0' )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) as participatedSubActivityCount FROM ofa_activities a WHERE a.parent_activity_id = #{activityId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tmsdata t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM ofa_activities_tech t WHERE t.activity_id = a.activity_id AND t.del_flag = '0' )

SELECT a.activity_id, a.activity_code, a.activity_name, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.activity_type, CASE a.activity_type WHEN '0' THEN '经颅磁技术' WHEN '1' THEN 'VR技术' WHEN '2' THEN '生物反馈技术' WHEN '3' THEN '内观技术' WHEN '9' THEN '其它' ELSE '未知' END as activityTypeName, a.appored, CASE a.appored WHEN '0' THEN '待审批' WHEN '1' THEN '发布中' WHEN '2' THEN '已发布报名中' WHEN '3' THEN '活动中' WHEN '4' THEN '已结束' WHEN '5' THEN '已归档' ELSE '未知' END as apporedName FROM ofa_activities a WHERE a.activity_id = #{activityId} AND a.del_flag = '0'
